description: Turns a customer's unbilled time into a DRAFT invoice: one line per entry, or one per service (groupBy SERVICE), optionally only time up to a day. The time is marked billed on it; voiding the invoice or deleting the draft frees the time again. Nothing is posted or sent: tell the user the draft is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting (openInApp). Only for a person who manages time.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

customer.description: The customer, by its exact name.

groupBy.description: ENTRY (one line per entry, default) or SERVICE (one line per service and rate).

through.description: Bill only time up to this day, yyyy-MM-dd.

name: bill_time
title: Bill unbilled time (draft invoice)
